name: Costco Anywhere Visa Card by Citi
perks: 5% on Costco gas and 4% on other eligible gas and EV charging, on the first $7,000 combined annually; 1% thereafter.
3% restaurants and eligible travel; 2% other Costco purchases; 1% elsewhere.
Paid Costco membership required; rewards issued as an annual certificate.
drawbacks: A current paid Costco membership is required.
